does: Creates a sense of depth by layering mountains, trees, and clouds.
Uses light and shadow to emphasize the drama of the landscape.
refuses: Flattening the scene into a single plane.
reading.tension: The interplay between the dark, looming mountain and the vibrant, sunlit foreground creates a dynamic contrast.
materialFacts: The surface shows detailed brushwork in the trees and foliage.
The sky is painted with soft, blended strokes to depict clouds and light.
structuralMoves: The composition is divided into foreground, middle ground, and background.
The central peak is placed slightly off-center to draw the eye upward.

leakage.work: A View of the Mountain Pass Called the Notch of the White Mountains
